citations.quote: Covenant Debt means the Group's total debt at IFRS carrying value excluding both finance and operating lease obligations, with no other exclusions or pro-forma adjustments.

The Borrower shall maintain the ratio of Covenant Net Debt to Covenant EBITDA at not more than 4.00x, tested at every calendar quarter end from December 31, 2025.
